resource.permission_basis: Official PhosX 0.23.1 distribution includes these exact HDF5 bytes under its Apache-2.0 package license; local computation and numeric derived outputs. No separate data exception found in this pinned distribution. Original atlas publication and separate kinase_pssms repository are not relicensed by this statement.
resource.redistribution_reason: Conservative export boundary: matrices and background supplied separately with identical hashes; package includes derived scores only.
resource.enzyme_mapping_inspection: bundled metadata supplies family/specificity/sequences, not a verified accession crosswalk; inferred enzyme taxon remains unknown
